purpose: Define exact post-run B/C/D provenance receipts and a v2 native-fluid table contract; admission, execution, native integrity, metrics, and T1 adjudication remain separate gates.

required_before_any_stage: independently authenticated authority authorizes this exact case, stage, executable/wrapper SHA-256, exact argv, input bindings, output root, invocation budget, CPU/memory/disk/walltime/process limits, and expiry
independent resource/scheduling gate passes for the exact envelope
the exclusive output root does not exist and no lock, receipt, manifest, or output is present
all frozen scope/input/definition-control checks pass without native tool invocation
prelaunch_admission_contract.lock_creation: Only after all admission checks pass, executor uses exclusive-create to consume the one-shot namespace and writes a lock binding authority SHA-256, stage, attempt_id, nonce, scope_id, case_id, exclusive output root, and created_at_utc before starting any native process.
prelaunch_admission_contract.failed_or_expired_admission: No namespace or lock is created; do not retry using the same authority/nonce.

detached_manifest_contract.canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON with ASCII object keys, keys sorted lexicographically, separators ',' and ':', ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, and exactly one trailing LF; arrays preserve contract order; all time values are canonical IEEE-754 binary64 hex strings, never JSON numbers.
detached_manifest_contract.sha256_subject: SHA-256 of the exact detached manifest file bytes, not an enclosing mutable receipt.
detached_manifest_contract.immutability: Manifest path is exclusive-created once, never overwritten; receipt binds its exact byte count and SHA-256.
detached_manifest_contract.no_self_or_downstream_hashes: A manifest may bind only its own stage inputs and outputs; it must not contain its own hash, its enclosing receipt hash, or any downstream manifest/receipt/table hash.
detached_manifest_contract.tree_closure_fields: Every output-tree manifest has separate files and directories arrays. files are sorted unique relative paths with bytes/SHA-256/type/link-count; directories are sorted unique relative paths. Their union must equal the recursively enumerated tree exactly.

common_bundle_contract.directory_entry_type: A relative POSIX path string; the directory itself has no bytes/hash or hardlink-count field.

receipt_reference_bindings.upstream_receipt_path_encoding: Absolute normalized path to the immutable upstream receipt; bind its exact bytes and SHA-256. This is distinct from bundle-internal relative paths.

common_bundle_contract.authorization_and_lock_encoding: UTF-8 JSON using sorted ASCII keys, compact separators, no NaN/Infinity, and exactly one trailing LF; caller trust is over the exact bytes/hash.
common_bundle_contract.outputs_subtree: all stage outputs; its recursive file and directory set must equal that stage's detached output manifest exactly

authorization_binding.expiry_semantics: A passed stage must end no later than expires_at_utc. An attempt ending after expiry is retained only as a failed/incomplete attempt and cannot be accepted as passed.

stage_B_materialization.scope_membership: case_id must identify exactly one qualification_only=true row in the frozen 15-row R008 scope; production, anchor, historical, and unknown rows reject

input_and_output_binding_shapes.definition_binding: exact {path,bytes,sha256}, must equal the frozen pack row and actual bytes
input_and_output_binding_shapes.control_binding: exact {path,bytes,sha256}, must equal the frozen pack row and actual bytes
input_and_output_binding_shapes.generated_xml_path: exact {path,bytes,sha256}; path is bundle-internal outputs-relative with literal outputs/ prefix
input_and_output_binding_shapes.initial_bi4_path: exact {path,bytes,sha256}; path is bundle-internal outputs-relative with literal outputs/ prefix
input_and_output_binding_shapes.metadata_binding: exact {manifest,manifest_sha256}; manifest is the exact read-only safe metadata API result and is recomputed from initial_bi4_path

frozen_input_checks: Definition/control canonical relative paths, byte counts, and SHA-256 exactly equal the frozen definition-control pack row
Read bytes with no-follow regular-file descriptors and call the pinned validate_case(row, definition_bytes, control_bytes, control_basename)
Recompute generated XML fluid and nonfluid ID cohorts; require unique disjoint complete uint32 ranges and bind generated XML hash
Recompute geometry, boundary, normal, particle-count, and native-initial required-array gates from files; never accept receipt booleans alone
stage_B_materialization.mass_reference_binding: Recompute the initial native BI4 root/global MassFluid value with the safe parser metadata-binding API; require JBinaryData type double (type_code 12), bind exact little-endian IEEE-754 bytes and float.hex value, require finite positive binary64 kg/particle, and use this immutable per-particle reference later. XML's %.15E rendering is display-only, not the source of exact bits; mass is not computed from dynamic Rhop.
stage_B_materialization.qualification_effect: materialization provenance only; no solver/T1 result or credit

raw_output_manifest.upstream_materialization_receipt_binding: C materialization_receipt_binding is exact {path,bytes,sha256}; path is the absolute normalized B receipt path.

tree_closure_fields.directories: sorted exact recursive output directory paths

raw_output_manifest.expected_time_axis_construction: Read frozen row native_output_dt_s, observation_end_s, and full_native_output_rows_to_timemax as binary64/bounded integer. For N rows, set t[0]=positive binary64 zero; for 1<=i<N-1 compute one IEEE-754 binary64 multiplication float(i)*float(native_output_dt_s) (no cumulative addition); set t[N-1]=binary64(observation_end_s) exactly. Encode each with float.hex(). Require N>=2, finite strict increase, last equals the frozen endpoint, and the frozen row's TimeMax/cadence validator passes.
raw_output_manifest.expected_time_source: The C manifest records only expected_time_s_ieee754_hex constructed from the frozen row by the operation above. Stage C does not parse BI4 metadata or claim an observed TimeStep.

stage_C_solver_attempt.qualification_effect: raw solver-attempt provenance only; no native integrity/T1 decision or credit

decoder_contract.caller_trust_gate: Caller supplies exact immutable Terra High review-receipt bytes after authenticating them out-of-band. The verifier requires the frozen PASS receipt schema/record/model/reasoning/agent/verdict and read-only execution boundary, checks its digest against the D receipt, extracts the reviewed source bindings, no-follow stable-reads all three local source files, and recomputes their byte counts/SHA-256 before D provenance recomputation. It does not authenticate the caller's review receipt or reviewer identity.

runtime_module_identity_boundary.assumption: The caller must invoke the verifier in a trusted fresh Python process with a pinned import path and no module monkeypatch/import-cache poisoning. The verifier cannot independently prove the identity of Python module objects imported before this function runs.

metadata_binding_api.version_and_sha256: Exact source version and SHA-256 are supplied by the independent review receipt and verified before use; this API source is itself hash-bound, not transitively assumed from the v1 scanner review.
metadata_binding_api.input: The held, no-follow raw BI4 descriptor and expected raw-solver manifest SHA-256 are passed to the same bounded JBinaryData parser; API re-hashes and re-checks descriptor identity before and after parsing.
metadata_binding_api.raw_value_bytes_encoding: Numeric values are their JBinaryData little-endian wire bytes; text values are exact UTF-8 bytes.
metadata_binding_api.float_hex_cardinality: For scalar float/double values, float_hex_components has exactly one element; float3/double3 have exactly three. Non-floating values have an empty list.
metadata_binding_api.raw_bits_source: Capture from the typed ValueRecord produced by the bounded BI4 parser, not by reparsing its %.15E XML rendering.

time_representation.source: The selected PART item's type-double TimeStep metadata is read by the safe metadata-binding API directly from raw BI4; XML TimeStep is display-only.
time_representation.canonical_value: C raw-solver-manifest.json stores only expected_time_s_ieee754_hex from the frozen schedule. D decoded-frame-manifest.json stores both expected_time_s_ieee754_hex and parser-observed_time_s_ieee754_hex from the raw BI4 metadata binding; require exact binary64 bit equality, not tolerance-based equality, before table construction.
time_representation.table_value: Only after the D expected/observed bit-equality gate passes, reconstruct each HDF5 time dataset value from parser-observed_time_s_ieee754_hex; its binary64 bits must match exactly.

array_type_contract.Pos: float3 count x 3; exactly one of Pos or Posd
array_type_contract.Posd: double3 count x 3; exactly one of Pos or Posd

mass_density_and_identity_closure.density_source: Rhop array, mapped by raw Idp; all Npok raw values are finite and strictly positive.
mass_density_and_identity_closure.mass_source: Root/global JBinaryData MassFluid type-double value from the safe metadata-binding API, captured from raw BI4 as exact little-endian IEEE-754 bytes and positive finite binary64 kg/particle for every frame.
mass_density_and_identity_closure.mass_binding: Every frame MassFluid must exactly equal the stage-B initial native BI4 MassFluid binary64 value; convert once using IEEE-754 binary32 round-to-nearest-ties-to-even, require the converted value finite and strictly positive (reject overflow/underflow-to-zero), then broadcast that exact binary32 scalar across the fluid particle axis. Never derive per-frame mass as Rhop*dp^3.
mass_density_and_identity_closure.generated_xml_id_cohort: Recompute all fluid, fixed, moving, and floating [begin, begin+count) ranges from the exact B-bound generated GenCase XML; require ranges to be pairwise disjoint and their union to equal exactly [0, CaseNp), and group totals to equal global CaseNfluid/CaseNfixed/CaseNmoving/CaseNfloat.
mass_density_and_identity_closure.raw_frame_id_cohort: For every frame, raw little-endian Idp must contain every ID in the complete fluid plus all registered nonfluid generated-XML cohorts exactly once; no missing, duplicate, unknown, unclassified, or out-of-range ID is permitted. Recompute the sorted fluid projection by ID; never filter an incomplete/unknown raw cohort and then accept it.
mass_density_and_identity_closure.counts: PART Npok, all required array counts, generated XML CaseNp, and exact raw Idp length must be equal for each frame.

detached_decoded_frame_manifest.manifest_digest_subject: Exact canonical detached manifest bytes, never the enclosing D receipt.
detached_decoded_frame_manifest.upstream_solver_receipt_binding: D solver_receipt_binding is exact {path,bytes,sha256}; path is the absolute normalized C receipt path.
detached_decoded_frame_manifest.raw_solver_binding_rule: For each decoded frame, raw_solver_manifest_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the entire canonical detached C manifest; raw_solver_ordinal must equal the frame ordinal; raw_path/raw_bytes/raw_sha256 must exactly equal that ordinal's entry and the corresponding C files-tree entry. No per-entry digest is implied.

tree_closure_fields.files: sorted unique relative paths with byte/hash/type/link closure
tree_closure_fields.directories: sorted unique relative directory paths, including empty directories

stage_D_decode_table_provenance.hash_direction: Stage-B receipt binds the B detached manifest; stage-C receipt binds the B receipt plus detached raw solver manifest; stage-D receipt binds the C receipt, detached decoded-frame manifest, D outputs manifest, and final table SHA-256. The table may bind only upstream B/C receipts and detached raw/decoded manifest hashes; authorization and lock contain prelaunch authority only. No authorization, lock, manifest, or table embeds its own hash, enclosing receipt hash, or a downstream hash.
stage_D_decode_table_provenance.qualification_effect: provenance/table binding only; native-integrity gates, metrics, comparisons, and T1 adjudication remain separate

threat_model_limits: SHA-256 detects content changes but does not authenticate a signer or establish trusted wall-clock time.
The verifier requires a caller-supplied trusted authority binding; internal self-consistent authorization JSON is not enough.
Bundle-root caller must exclude ACL, capability, privileged-mount, and same-UID concurrent mutation paths; all reads remain descriptor-relative and no-follow below held roots.
